question: Can an explicitly authored conservative contact boundary preserve the scan's distinctive visible volume and form a coherent limb selection better than the current provisional partition?

hypotheses.meaning: Retain the current provisional boundary; available evidence does not justify a change.
A boundary following a specifically identified source-visible contact/seam forms a more coherent limb without losing genuine belly or paw volume.
The scan cannot distinguish the boundary; a conservative authored interpretation is necessary and must remain labelled authored.

independentVariable: One contact's anatomical assignment map. Record exact changed full-r4 face IDs before rendering the candidate.
controls: Original scan and V2 input hashes
Source vertex positions, face winding and UV correspondence
Camera, origin, framing, lighting and display transform

measurements.name: Changed assignment area
measurements.units: native units squared and fraction of retained V2 area
measurements.purpose: Quantify the actual extent of the hypothesis; not confidence.

measurements.name: Geometry / UV preservation
measurements.purpose: Reject an assignment-only candidate that silently alters shape or texture mapping.

measurements.name: Connectivity and attachment reach
measurements.units: components, boundary junctions and source-space distances
measurements.purpose: Expose disconnected shells and retained seated volume; graph regularity does not decide anatomy.

measurements.name: Matched visual interpretation
measurements.units: specific face sets and supported / contradicted / unresolved observations
measurements.purpose: Check visible belly, limb continuity, asymmetry and paw shape in texture, clay and isolation.

criteria: Reject silent changes to any controlled source quantity.
Reject removal of plausible scanned belly/limb volume merely to simplify a boundary.
Reject a proposed leg that contains only the obvious paw shell while leaving identified seated leg surfaces with the torso.
Prefer a changed boundary only when specific visible evidence supports its anatomical interpretation; save counter-evidence too.
If visible evidence is insufficient, retain unresolved status or explicitly choose an authored interpretation; do not call it measured anatomy.
Do not advance to standing or walking until the saved static interpretation has a separate visual review.
decisionChangingEvidence: A reproducible source-visible seam/attachment interpretation that retains genuine body volume and survives matched isolation/assembly review, or new source observations of the contact.
insufficientEvidence: Old bone weights or part names
limits: Photographic coverage of hidden contacts UNKNOWN
No production mesh, rig or gameplay write authorized by a passing baseline check
